positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description: Developed software to be used on a custom drone for capturing sports games for both streaming to audiences and post-game analysis by coaches. Developed player recognition software with 94% accuracy using custom data-collection program and convolutional neural networks to integrate with “auto-editing” post-processing of video using OpenCV. Conducted market research via interviews to determine the product is feasible in the sports market.
positions.insights: Skills: Image Processing · Market Analysis · Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) · Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language) · OpenCV · Interviewing · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Computer Vision

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description: Built a tool to aid PMO in bidding successfully on contracts by suggesting optimal bid price. Created and visualized new metrics which helped identify $25 million in room for sector growth. Maintained and organized large database of contract details. Wrote technical contact proposals.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Writing · Data Analysis · Data Visualization
